'''Paul Davis''' (born July 21, 1984) is an American retired professional [[basketball]] player. Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=11}}, he played at the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] and [[Center (basketball)|center]] positions.

==Early years==
Davis attended [[Rochester Community Schools (Michigan)|Reuther Middle School]] where his number has been retired.{{cn|date=January 2026}} Davis played for [[Rochester High School (Michigan)|Rochester High School]], earning [[Mr. Basketball of Michigan]] honors in 2002.

As a [[Center (basketball)|center]] for the [[Michigan State University athletics#Men's basketball|Michigan State Spartans]], he finished the 2005 season as the [[NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Championship|NCAA Tournament]]'s leading rebounder. Davis was ranked as the nation's number three center by ''Lindy's College Basketball'' and the nation's number five [[Center (basketball)|post man]] by ''Athlon Sports''.

In his senior season, he averaged 17.5 points, 9.1 rebounds, 1.6 assists, 1 steal and 0.9 blocks, while also shooting 87% from the free-throw line, and was 6–19 from three-point territory. Paul finished his college career with 1,718 points.

On April 2, 2009, Paul appeared on the Bravo show ''[[Millionaire Matchmaker]]''.<ref>[http://blogs.suntimes.com/sportsprose/2009/04/paul_davis_millionaire_matchmaker_nba.html Former Clipper Paul Davis appears on 'Millionaire Matchmaker'] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090406084342/http://blogs.suntimes.com/sportsprose/2009/04/paul_davis_millionaire_matchmaker_nba.html |date=April 6, 2009 }}</ref>

==Professional career==

===NBA===
On June 28, 2006, Davis was selected by the [[Los Angeles Clippers]] in the [[2006 NBA draft]] with the 34th pick (4th pick of 2nd round).

After [[2007–08 NBA season|2007–08 season]], he became a restricted free agent. His rights were renounced by the Clippers, but on August 18, 2008, he was re-signed by the Clippers.<ref>{{cite web | title=Clippers Sign Paul Davis | work=[[NBA.com]] | url=http://www.nba.com/clippers/news/pdavis_080818.html | access-date=August 18, 2008}}</ref> He was waived by the Clippers in January 2009.<ref name="Clippers Waive">[http://www.nba.com/clippers/news/davis_jones_waived_090105.html Clippers Waive Paul Davis and Fred Jones]</ref><ref>{{cite news| title=Clippers waive Fred Jones, Paul Davis; Cheikh Samb checks in| work=Los Angeles Times|url=http://www.latimes.com/sports/la-sp-clippersfyi6-2009jan06,0,1905189.story|access-date=January 29, 2009 | first=Lisa | last=Dillman | date=January 6, 2009}}</ref>

On September 25, 2009, Davis signed with the [[Washington Wizards]]. He was waived on November 11, 2009, when the Wizards signed guard [[Earl Boykins]].<ref>[https://www.espn.com/nba/news/story?id=4645193 Wizards sign guard Boykins]</ref>

===European clubs===
On April 8, 2010, Davis signed with [[Obradoiro CAB|Xacobeo Blu:Sens]], a Spanish [[Liga ACB|ACB]] team.<ref name="sens ficha">[http://www.obradoirocab.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=367 O Xacobeo Blu:sens ficha ao americano Paul Davis] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20111008152900/http://www.obradoirocab.com/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=367 |date=October 8, 2011 }} {{in lang|es}}</ref> In September 2010 he signed with [[CB Sevilla|CB Cajasol Sevilla]].<ref>[http://www.talkbasket.net/news/cajasol-seville-signed-paul-davis-3466.html Cajasol Seville signed Paul Davis] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100728061518/http://www.talkbasket.net/news/cajasol-seville-signed-paul-davis-3466.html |date=July 28, 2010 }}</ref>

After two seasons at Seville, in May 2012 he signed a two-year deal with the Russian club [[BC Khimki]], to join them for the [[EuroLeague]] competition.<ref>[http://en.bckhimki.ru/news/clubnews/2012/may/864/ BC Khimki adds Paul Davis]</ref> In July 2014, he re-signed with Khimki for one more season.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20140714135753/http://www.eurocupbasketball.com/eurocup/news/i/138341 Khimki keeps big man Davis]</ref> On July 11, 2015, he signed another one-year extension with the club.<ref>{{cite news|title=Khimki keep Paul Davis one more season|url=http://www.sportando.com/en/europe/russia/168287/khimki-keep-paul-davis-one-more-season.html|access-date=July 12, 2015|work=sportando.com|date=July 11, 2015}}</ref>

On June 27, 2016, Davis announced his retirement from professional basketball due to constant injuries.<ref>{{cite news|title=Paul Davis retired at age 31|url=http://www.eurohoops.net/featured/269039/paul-davis-retired-at-age-31|publisher=Eurohoops|date=June 27, 2016|access-date=June 27, 2016}}</ref>

== Personal life ==

=== Controversies ===
Davis was kicked out of a January 2026 Michigan State Spartans basketball game after "verbally abusing" a referee. Michigan State Coach [[Tom Izzo]] (who previously coached Davis) acknowledged the ejection at his after game press conference, stating "What he said, he should never say in the world. That ticked me off".

Davis expressed regret for his comments the next day, sharing he had called the official to offer his apologies. <ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-01-06 |title=Ex-MSU star Paul Davis apologizes for verbally abusing ref |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/47531725/ex-msu-star-paul-davis-apologizes-verbally-abusing-ref |access-date=2026-01-18 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>
